Oct 1, 2023

## [Ridiculously high shipping cost but POOR handling&shipping service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6518a2f3beccf847af1f59e3)
Lulu and Georgia charges shipping and handling a lot more than any other furniture store and you would think that they would use a "premium" delivery service. They use FedEx and the fedex delivery left our rug shipment outside in the rain without even ringing our door bell. The water seeped through the packaging on both ends.

If you're charging "premium" shipping price, you better step up with your shipping service carrier, or at the very least you have to tell them to handle your packages with care, otherwise, STOP charging "premium" shipping price or use REAL premium shipping service like other stores.

September 23, 2023

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Oct 3, 2023

Hi Meliana, Thank you for your feedback! We have shared this with our teams and are working to improve shipping processes in the future. Apologies for any inconvenience that this experience has caused you. We are incredibly sorry to hear about the condition of the rug that was delivered. We are more than happy to help with some alternative suggestions. Just reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com if you’re interested.
